items.name: Pain is the first thing to check
Dark blood or weight loss is a red flag

closing.headline: Check whether it hurts before assuming any blood after a bowel movement is just hemorrhoids.
closing.tip: Enough fiber and fluids to keep stool soft is the basic first step for both.
closing.cta: Unusual color or increasing blood means it's worth having a doctor check.
